# `aitbc wallet multisig-create`

Create a multi-signature wallet with a threshold and a list of signers.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc wallet multisig-create [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--signers` | text (multiple) | — | yes | One or more signer addresses. |
| `--threshold` | integer | — | yes | Required signatures to approve |
| `--name` | text | — | yes | Multisig wallet name |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc wallet multisig-create --signers <signers> --threshold <threshold> --name <name>
```
